name: socialpro-szamlazz
description: Issue, cancel, and fetch Hungarian invoices via the szamlazz.hu Agent API — directly from Claude Code. VAT-aware, with NAV taxpayer lookup and automatic partner cache. Cross-platform.

agentKey.description: Your szamlazz.hu Agent API key. Generate one at szamlazz.hu → Beállítások → Számla Agent kulcsok. Stored securely via your OS credential store (Keychain on macOS, Credential Manager on Windows, Secret Service on Linux).

configDir.description: Optional custom config directory. Defaults: ./.szamlazz/ (project-local), or OS-default (~/Library/Application Support/szamlazz on macOS, %APPDATA%\szamlazz on Windows, $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/szamlazz on Linux).
